steps.caption: Games has a Daily tile: puzzles of the day
steps.shows: The Games launcher, twelve tiles; Daily (a calendar page with a star) second row left, 'Maths and Sudoku' under it

steps.caption: Tap Daily: Daily maths and Sudoku, a new puzzle every day
steps.shows: The Daily screen: Sunday, 22 November 2026; rows for Daily maths ('5 a day') and Sudoku ('Easy, Medium or Hard'); 'New puzzles every day, the same on every board.'

steps.caption: Tap Sudoku and pick a level: Easy, Medium or Hard
steps.shows: Today's sudoku card: Easy (36 to 40 clues, singles solve it), Medium (30 to 34 clues), Hard (26 to 29 clues)

steps.caption: Today's Easy puzzle, the same on every board; givens are bold
steps.shows: A fresh Easy board, 36 givens in bold, the clock at 0:00, the number pad, Erase, Pencil, Undo (thin: nothing to undo); 'Tap a square, then a number.'

steps.caption: Tap a square: it is ringed, its row, column and box are hatched
steps.shows: Row 1 column 5 ringed; its row, column and box hatched lightly; Easy 0:12; '45 squares to go'

steps.caption: Then tap a number to put it in
steps.shows: A 5 (regular type, yours) in the ringed square; Easy 0:23; '44 squares to go'

steps.caption: Pencil on: numbers go in small, as notes
steps.shows: Pencil filled black, the pad's numbers small; pencil marks 2 and 3 in row 1 column 6; 'Pencil is on: numbers go in small, as notes.'

steps.caption: A number that clashes is struck through, never refused
steps.shows: An 8 in row 2 column 1 struck through (the row already has a given 8); 'Struck through: the same number twice in a row, column or box.'

steps.caption: Undo takes it back
steps.shows: Row 2 column 1 empty and ringed again; Easy 1:12; '44 squares to go'

steps.caption: One square to go; the numbers already placed nine times fade on the pad
steps.shows: Last empty square (row 9 column 5) ringed; the pad shows 8 bold and the other numbers thin; Easy 2:17; '1 square to go'

steps.caption: Solved: your time, a best, and your streak. Come back tomorrow
steps.shows: The full grid; 'Solved!', 'Solved in 2:28', 'A new best time!', '1 day in a row', 'Come back tomorrow for a new one.'
